trackedRisks: CA-001: the system end-to-end test cannot pass until dataset validation, sandbox records, independent evaluation, and rule specification exist.
Manual sandbox evidence depends on a person running the assistant on the virtual machine.

topPriorityItems.reason: A human-named assistant reaches this agent only as an orchestrator assignment and must become a sourced registry entry.
Adding an assistant must be visible to a human.
A hypothesis without a signal, observation, sources, and measurements cannot be validated.
The system test is the acceptance check from research through a submitted rule specification.
A hypothesis with no source must not enter the pipeline.
Weak sources must stop as an unresolved investigation.
The end-to-end test must not start a shopping agent.
Discovery of new assistants and new patterns runs on a configured cadence that defaults to 24 hours.
